newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Bldg soc payout significant addition to income-BoE.
newsitem.headline: Bldg soc payout significant addition to income-BoE.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said building society payouts totalling 30 to 35 billion stg as a result of stock market flotations meant a significant addition to U.K. personal income.
He told reporters it was unsure what proportions of the money would be saved at home or abroad or spent, but the authorities would have to make their best assessment of this.

"We have a pretty clear idea of the amounts involved -- 30 to 35 billion pounds, which is significant in relation to personal income or total expenditure," he said at the International Monetary Conference in Interlaken.
